args.reason: The --dry-run DoD item serves the inspection goal, but the persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log and the --explain timeline with --since and --format are historical storage and query features, which the PRD explicitly declares outside its scope. That DoD capability is not a subset of the declared goals. The Phase-1 view that history is a natural extension of inspection contradicts the PRD text, which limits inspection to the current decision.
